title: More FPS
items: New built-in mods: More Culling, C2ME, Krypton and Sodium Extra.
FPS Optimizer limits the frame rate while a menu is open in a world (60 FPS by default, you can change it).
The Optimize button also keeps the simulation distance at 8 or less and applies the fastest Sodium Extra options.
The client does less work every frame: faster cosmetics, HUD and mods menu.

title: Pumpkins, mob faces and a faster menu
items: Masks and hats sit outside your skin's 3D layer, and back cosmetics and wings move out when you wear a chestplate or elytra.
Jack-o'-Lantern turns into a glowing carved pumpkin at random, while you fight or hold a sword, or both.
Waypoints: name them when you add them, rename them and change their size.
Gap Counter: new pumpkin style and a coloured counter in your hotbar.
Sound Tweaks: pick any mob by its face to mute it (iron golems, slimes...).
Music Player: hotkeys for play, next, back, volume, stop and shuffle, and songs from direct MP3/WAV links.
Target HUD shows the face of the mob you fight.
The Neon menu is much lighter, every theme has its own details, and mods are split by letter.
Reworked Neon, Niko and Windy Bee pets.

title: Totems, auras and a smarter menu
items: TotemPop: smaller totem animation on screen and new totem particles (feathers with a glowing halo, or golden sparks).
Aura cosmetic: angel light, devil embers, sky sparkles, stars, hearts, feathers or music notes around you.
Hit Particles: new pixel feathers, like the wings.
Chat heads, a movable scoreboard without red numbers, Nether coords and a weapon break alert.
Favorite mods with the star, and the search now finds options inside every mod.
The client now tells you when there is an update and installs it with one click.

title: Sounds and options
items: HitSounds: pixel pop, bell, laser, coin, punch, angel harp, devil and click, each with a crit version.
Every option with several modes now shows all of them at once.

title: Pets and skies
items: Angel Devil and Cloud pets follow you, wave, celebrate your kills, nap when you are AFK and hide when you are low.
Halo styles: ring, broken, crown and devil horns.
Main menu sky: sunset, starry night, day or real time, with parallax.
Music Player for your own MP3 files and an animated gradient name.
